projects.name: Project Sail Data Center, Cheyenne
projects.description: Cheyenne/Laramie County data center and powered-land pipeline activity in 2026. Wyoming targeting hyperscale energy-adjacent development.

sources.title: Wyoming data center pipeline, state economic development

projects.name: Microsoft Highlands Data Center Campus
projects.description: Microsoft closed on 3,460 acres (Highlands tract) and secured Cheyenne City Council annexation approval on July 14, 2026 for a multi-billion dollar, multi-decade hyperscale data center campus.

sources.title: Cheyenne passes Microsoft data center land annexation - Cap City News

projects.open_for: Planning & entitlement. Infrastructure, utility connections, civil engineering.

projects.name: Google Project Tembo Data Center Campus
projects.description: Google unmasked as owner of 2.7-gigawatt Project Tembo (formerly Project Jade) in Switchgrass Industrial Park, 8 miles south of Cheyenne. Amended filings submitted June 30, 2026 for 716-acre campus with 4 large data center halls and office hub.
key_specs: 4 large-scale data center halls & office hub

sources.title: Google Revealed As Owner Of Wyoming's Largest Data Center Project - Cowboy State Daily

projects.open_for: Permitting & site plan approval. Electrical grid interconnect, high-density cooling.

projects.name: Related Digital / CoreWeave Data Center Campus
projects.description: Related Digital broke ground July 2026 on a $1.2B, 302 MW campus in Cheyenne Business Parkway. First phase is a 184,000 SF building fully leased to CoreWeave delivering 88 MW, GC Clayco, completion late 2026.

sources.title: Related Digital breaks ground on 302 MW data center campus in Cheyenne

projects.open_for: Under construction. Shell completion late 2026, MEP & liquid cooling fit-out.

projects.name: Target Hyper/Scale Workforce Hub & Prometheus Data Center
projects.owner: Target Hospitality / Target Hyper/Scale / Prometheus Hyperscale
projects.description: Uinta County approved Conditional Use Permit on July 21, 2026 for Target Hyper/Scale to build a workforce hub near Bear River State Park supporting construction of Prometheus Hyperscale's 1.25 GW data center (up to 3,500 workers).

sources.title: Uinta County Commission approves man camp permit - Wyoming News

projects.open_for: Permitting. Modular building procurement, infrastructure, civil utilities.
